Odisha's temple architecture from the old town of Bhubaneswar to the Sun Temple at Konark, with the Jain caves between.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • Bhubaneswar
  • The Ekamra temples
  • Udayagiri and Khandagiri
  • Konark

Day by day

  1. Day 1: Bhubaneswar

    Arrival, and how to read a Kalinga temple.

  2. Day 2: The Ekamra temples

    The old town and its sacred landscape.

  3. Day 3: Udayagiri and Khandagiri

    The Jain caves on the twin hills.

  4. Day 4: Konark

    The Sun Temple, then rest by the coast.

  5. Day 5: Iconography and departure

    A session comparing the sculpture you have seen.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Read a Kalinga temple and apply this to the temples of Bhubaneswar's old town.
  • Describe the Jain caves on the twin hills of Udayagiri and Khandagiri.
  • Compare the sculpture seen across the journey, including at the Sun Temple in Konark.

You take away

Your own notes and observations from each site.
